sub_graphs.title: EIP-7623: Calldata Gas Floor Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the new gas calculation mechanism with floor cost for calldata-heavy transactions

nodes.label: Transaction Received
nodes.description: Transaction received for gas calculation

nodes.label: Count Calldata Tokens
nodes.description: Calculate tokens_in_calldata = zero_bytes + (nonzero_bytes × 4)

nodes.label: Calldata Tokens Counted
nodes.description: Token count for calldata determined

nodes.label: Calculate Standard Gas Cost
nodes.description: Compute: 21000 + (4 × tokens) + execution_gas + isContractCreation × (32000 + 2 × words(calldata))

nodes.label: Standard Gas Cost Computed
nodes.description: Traditional gas cost calculated

nodes.label: Calculate Floor Gas Cost
nodes.description: Compute: 21000 + (10 × tokens_in_calldata)

nodes.label: Floor Gas Cost Computed
nodes.description: Floor gas cost calculated based on TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN=10

nodes.label: Select Maximum Gas
nodes.description: Apply max(standard_gas, floor_gas) to determine final gas used

nodes.label: Final Gas Determined
nodes.description: Final gas cost determined as maximum of standard and floor calculations

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7623: Transaction Gas Limit Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation of transaction gas limits against the new floor requirements

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Validation
nodes.description: Transaction received and pending gas limit validation

nodes.label: Compute Minimum Gas Limit
nodes.description: Calculate minimum required gas: max(21000 + (10 × tokens), intrinsic_gas_cost)

nodes.label: Minimum Gas Limit Computed
nodes.description: Minimum acceptable gas limit determined

nodes.label: Compare Gas Limit
nodes.description: Check if tx.gasLimit >= minimum_required_gas

nodes.label: Transaction Gas Valid
nodes.description: Transaction gas limit meets minimum requirements

nodes.label: Transaction Gas Invalid
nodes.description: Transaction rejected: gas limit below minimum floor

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7623: Transaction Type Classification
sub_graphs.description: Models how transactions are classified as data-heavy or computation-heavy for gas pricing

nodes.label: Transaction Executed
nodes.description: Transaction has completed EVM execution, execution_gas_used known

nodes.label: Calculate EVM to Calldata Ratio
nodes.description: Compare execution_gas_used against calldata token cost to determine transaction type

nodes.label: Computation-Heavy Transaction
nodes.description: Transaction classified as computation-heavy: standard gas >= floor gas (unaffected by EIP)

nodes.label: Data-Heavy Transaction
nodes.description: Transaction classified as data-heavy: floor gas > standard gas (pays higher rate)

nodes.label: Apply Standard Gas Rate
nodes.description: Apply 4/16 gas per byte for calldata (STANDARD_TOKEN_COST=4)

nodes.label: Apply Floor Gas Rate
nodes.description: Apply 10/40 gas per byte for calldata (TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN=10)

nodes.label: Gas Charged
nodes.description: Final gas amount charged to transaction

ambiguities.text: The term 'tokens_in_calldata' counts zero bytes as 1 token and non-zero bytes as 4 tokens, but the relationship to actual byte costs (4/16 vs 10/40) is not immediately clear
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume token count is an abstract unit for gas calculation. Zero byte costs 4 gas at standard rate (1 token × 4), non-zero costs 16 gas (4 tokens × 4). Floor rate applies 10 gas per token.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior if eth_estimateGas implementations are not updated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume transactions with underestimated gas will fail validation. Wallets MUST update gas estimation to account for floor.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallets and dApps using eth_estimateGas will update their implementations to account for the new floor pricing
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may submit transactions with insufficient gas that get rejected, leading to failed transactions and user confusion

implicit_assumptions.description: The 2.5x increase in calldata cost for data-heavy transactions is acceptable to L2 rollups and data posting use cases
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: L2 rollups may become economically unviable or need to implement alternative data availability solutions (e.g., blob transactions)

implicit_assumptions.description: Block builders cannot game the gas calculation to extract additional value from data-heavy transactions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: MEV opportunities could arise from manipulating transaction ordering based on calldata gas floor applicability
